ig.note: Initial attributions are preserved; flagged clauses are separately rerun at higher n_steps. Faithfulness uses rerun attributions for those clauses.

paired_review_bootstrap_top_minus_random.note: Reviews are resampled as clusters; clauses within a sampled review stay together.

faithfulness.note: Primary faithfulness comparison uses matched eligible clauses; low-attribution deletion is secondary.

stability.interpretation: Prediction agreement is summarized only over eligible edited inputs; it is not attribution stability.
